panels.description:
Packet-level error counters from RoCE NICs, summed across the fleet as event rates. Sustained non-zero values indicate loss that may sharply degrade RDMA throughput.

 - **Out of Sequence (Rx)**: packets arrived with a gap in the sequence number.
 - **Retransmitted (Tx)**: packets this node re-sent after a NAK or timeout.
 - **Discarded (Rx/Tx)**: RoCE packets dropped by the NIC itself rather than lost in the fabric, usually from buffer exhaustion or malformed traffic.

Availability is vendor-specific. An absent series is unsupported, not zero: Ethernet, InfiniBand, and Slingshot report none of these.

panels.title: Errors by Interface

panels.description:
Congestion exposure on this node's RoCE interfaces, in both directions.
  - **ECN Marked**: arriving packets flagged by a congested switch. Congestion on paths into this node.
  - **CNP Received**: notifications from remote receivers throttling this node's sends. Congestion on paths out of it.

Read each independently. They are counted at opposite ends of the DCQCN loop, on different nodes. A receive-heavy node can show ECN with no CNP and a send-heavy node the reverse. Both may rise during the same congestion episode, as symptoms of a common cause rather than one driving the other.

Availability is vendor-specific. An absent series is unsupported, not zero: Ethernet, InfiniBand, and Slingshot report none of these.
